desc:
CHOCOLATE FLAVORED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored milk chocolate frosting; Goes great with baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: This Betty Crocker frosting is the perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: Eight 16 oz tubs of Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Artificially Flavored Milk Chocolate Frosting
features:
Key Features:

Ready-to-Use Chocolate Frosting

Pre-made rich and creamy chocolate frosting that’s perfect for cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and brownies.

Smooth & Spreadable Texture

Designed for easy spreading and decorating right out of the container—no need to mix or whip.

Versatile Dessert Topping

Suitable for both everyday baking and special occasions like birthdays, school events, or holidays.

Consistent Flavor Profile

Delivers the classic chocolate flavor that many people associate with homemade baked goods.

Shelf-Stable & Convenient

Does not require refrigeration before opening and is ideal for keeping on hand in your pantry.

Benefits:

Time-Saving & Hassle-Free

Skip the process of making frosting from scratch—just open, apply, and enjoy.

Kid-Friendly Flavor

Sweet and mild chocolate taste that appeals to children and adults alike.

Perfect for Beginner Bakers

No professional tools or experience required—great for home bakers, school projects, or casual baking fun.

Reliable Brand Quality

Made by Betty Crocker, known for consistent and trustworthy baking products.

Flexible for Different Uses

Whether you’re layering it on a cake, dipping fruit, or sandwiching cookies, it holds up well and tastes delicious.
ingredients: Sugar, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Water, Cocoa Processed With Alkali. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Monoglycerides, Polysorbate 60, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Citric Acid, Natural And Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
